dg-k-scale.alt: Two matched scales. Negative ΔG° on the left lines up with K greater than 1, products favored; positive ΔG° on the right lines up with K less than 1, reactants favored; ΔG° of zero lines up with K equal to 1. At 298 K, −20 kJ/mol gives K about 3 × 10³ and +20 kJ/mol gives K about 3 × 10⁻⁴.
